name: Overclock

runner.notes: Install the Overclock desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), connect existing CLI agent subscriptions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, etc.), open only runs/<run-id>/worktree as a mission workspace, run Free/Squad/Agentic mission with prompt.md, then harness-verify after merge to the prepared tree. Record plan tier, mission mode, guest agents/models, pane costs, and interventions.

inclusion: Direct Class A multi-agent ADE cockpit: pane grid for concurrent coding CLIs, missions with worktrees, maestro/squad orchestration, skills marketplace, and 52 native MCP tools.
pricing_model: Subscription cockpit only (models use the user's existing CLI subscriptions): Boost $19/month, Boost Pro $39/month, Ultra $79/month; 7-day refund guarantee stated on site. No separate model fee charged by Overclock.
public_stack_signals: Official site brands Overclock as an ADE for vibe coding with AI agents.
Desktop app on Mac, Windows, and Linux with automatic updates.
Connects user-owned CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio, and more) without re-billing models.
Missions in Free, Squad, or Agentic modes; each mission has panes, status, and worktree.
Claims 16 product surfaces and 52 native MCP tools for maestro spawn/delegate/sync.
capabilities_to_probe: multi-pane concurrent Claude/Codex/Gemini sessions with live cost
mission worktree isolation and status tracking
moat_hypotheses: cockpit that monetizes orchestration UX while BYO agent subscriptions
ready-made squads/recipes reduce multi-agent setup friction
dense MCP tool surface for maestro coordination without user YAML
setup_notes: Requires authenticated guest CLIs on the machine; Overclock does not supply model tokens.
Plan tier gates Squad/recipes/voice/Jarvis/agentic mission features — record tier.
Mission worktrees may nest outside harness main; verify merge path before scoring.

Maestro MCP tool depth is hard for thin terminal multiplexers to copy quickly.
Community and PT-BR voice UX create regional distribution advantage.
evidence: Official site lists concurrent CLI support, mission worktrees, squads, and pricing without model re-billing.
Features page enumerates 16+ surfaces including MCP, OverMemory, and voice.
